verdict.rationale: Adyen's Dynamic 3D Secure lets merchants set rules for which card payments go through 3DS and whether they are challenged. That covers the risk-based 3DS-triggering half of the story. The pack does not show PSD2/SCA-specific handling such as automatic exemption requests (TRA, low-value, trusted beneficiary) or regulation-driven routing for European traffic. missing for 10: documented SCA exemption requesting, PSD2/European-specific compliance routing logic, evidence of conversion impact, independent or hands-on corroboration.
